prompt:
Edit the first input paint_mask_guide.png in place. Use case: precise-object-edit. Output ONE transparent RGBA PNG, 1536x2048, 3:4 canvas. This is a technical paint plus material-mask orthographic view atlas, NOT a new illustration. Input 1 is the exact layout and silhouette guide, input 2 design_reference.png is the approved material/detail reference, input 3 icon_x8.png is original colour reference (magenta is background).
Preserve all ten silhouettes exactly in their original positions, sizes, orientations, outlines and gaps. Three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 contain five views FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. Rows 3-4 repeat those five views. In the guide the first two cells are tiny end-on circular views; preserve these tiny circles! Third cell has a horizontal pike pointing LEFT. Row 2 column 1 has a horizontal pike pointing RIGHT; row 2 column 2 has a vertical pike pointing UP. Repeat identical layout in lower half. Do not enlarge objects to fill cells. Empty cells column 3 rows 2 and 4 remain fully transparent.
Paint only grey objects in rows 1-2 with unlit base colour: Faithfully extrapolate the complete MM9 Pike in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the long plain reddish-brown wooden shaft with sparse pale metal bands, gold socket and butt cap, small red-orange flared collar, slender symmetric pale-silver leaf point with central ridge. Follow the approved design at each view's tiny scale. No added ornamentation. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow reference if present. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, halos, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text.
Rows 3-4 are MATERIAL MASK ONLY, same silhouettes filled with FLAT pure classification colours. Every metal part including gold socket, silver blade, pale metal bands and gold butt cap = pure red #FF0000; leather/fur = pure green #00FF00; cloth/hair/cord = pure blue #0000FF; matte solid wood/bone/horn/stone/paper/wax = pure yellow #FFFF00; gemstone/crystal/glass/pearl/enamel/liquid in glass = pure black #000000. Wood shaft is yellow. Every silhouette pixel must get exactly one of these colours, no shading, no texture, no outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside. Nothing outside silhouettes. Preserve transparency and every opening exactly. Paint guide only, never redraw, move, resize, redesign or rearrange.
CORRECTION: Exact silhouette boundaries are essential. The previous attempt had coloured noise and red speckles outside the objects, thickened edges and ragged extensions. Eliminate all of these. Use the original grey guide as a strict alpha stencil: absolutely zero painted pixels outside its silhouettes, including around the collar, blade, shaft and end caps. Clean smooth edges. No red outline on PAINT views. Lower mask views have perfectly solid flat red and yellow regions with crisp clean boundaries, no speckles, no gradients, no extra shapes. Preserve the guide's very thin shaft and exact geometry. Transparent background.
